trigger.raw_text: The Operator accesses the separate Daily Diary display to enter free form text comments.

claims.content: The separate “Daily Diary” display allows the user to enter free form text comments.
Operator enters free form text comments in the “Daily Diary” display.
The Operator Daily Diary Log records Operator Daily Diary Log ID, Personnel ID, Date, and Notes.
Each Operator Daily Diary Log entry is for one Personnel and references one Workstation.
At main flow step 0, when a user with Operator authority logs on to the system, the Daily Diary Log is generated automatically.
At main flow step 1, if the log entry is not for the user's own login, for the current day, or for the current shift, the user should not be able to update the log entry.

If the Operator attempts to update a log entry that is not for their own login, the user should not be able to update the log entry; exit the use case without updating the Operator Daily Diary Log entry.

If the Operator attempts to update a log entry that is not for the current day, the user should not be able to update the log entry; exit the use case without updating the Operator Daily Diary Log entry.

If the Operator attempts to update a log entry that is not for the current shift, the user should not be able to update the log entry; exit the use case without updating the Operator Daily Diary Log entry.
